+# Adapted from sdpa/bwd/kernels/sm100/bprop_sparse_d256_f16.py.
+
+"""Native packed QSA backward for Blackwell SM100/103.
+
+Each CTA reuses gathered K/V blocks across 12 or 24 query heads.
+The pipeline overlaps score, derivative, and gradient tensor-core work.
+"""
+
+import hashlib
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import cutlass
+import cutlass.cute as cute
+import cutlass.experimental.cuda as cuda
+from cuda.bindings import driver as cuda_driver
+from cutlass.cute.runtime import make_fake_stream
+from cutlass.experimental import primitives as prims
+
+from cudnn.frost.compiled_cache import compile_cached, template_key
+
+FROST_SOURCE_DIGEST = hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest()[:16]
+
+
+I32 = cutlass.Int32
+I64 = cutlass.Int64
+F32 = cutlass.Float32
+BF16 = cutlass.BFloat16
+
+GQ = 12
+D = 256
+LOG2E = 1.4426950408889634
+
+NTHREADS = 512
+# Use whole 16-row dQ steps within the three operand stages.
+CHB = 10
+
+
+OFF_Q = 0  # Reserve 32 shared rows per slab; MMA padding stays zero.
+OFF_DO = 16384
+QSLAB = 4096
+OFF_K = 32768  # MMA row = 8 * block + 2 * token + head, so one block covers both KV heads
+BLK_SMEM = 4096  # Four slabs of eight SW128 rows per gathered block.
+SLAB = 1024
+K_STAGE = CHB * BLK_SMEM  # blocks sit at the 8-row-group stride of the MMA operand
+OFF_V = OFF_K + 2 * K_STAGE
+OFF_DS = OFF_V + K_STAGE
+DS_BYTES = 6144
+NDRAIN = 8
+EP_BYTES = 4096
+OFF_EP = OFF_DS + 3 * DS_BYTES
+SMEM_BYTES = OFF_EP + NDRAIN * EP_BYTES
+
+TM_S = 0
+TM_DP = 32
+TM_PT = 64
+TM_DST = 96
+TM_DQ = 128
+TM_SL = 192
+NSL = 5  # the most 64-column dV/dK slices that fit in the 512 TMEM columns after TM_SL
+L2_EVICT_FIRST = 0x12F0000000000000
+TM_COLS = 512
+
+Q_BOX_BYTES = 24 * 128
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _wait(bar, parity):
+    while not prims.mbarrier_try_wait_parity(bar, parity):
+        pass
+
+
+def _desc(addr, lbo, sbo, swz):
+    return prims.Tcgen05SmemDesc.build(start_address=addr, leading_byte_offset=lbo, stride_byte_offset=sbo, layout=swz)
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _bwd_slice(j, cgb, pb, b_le, b_lf, tmem_raw, d_do_mn, d_q_mn, idesc_kv, HKV: cutlass.Constexpr[int]):
+    gs = cgb * 8 + j
+    slot = gs % NSL
+    _wait(b_le.subview(slot), ((gs // NSL) & 1) ^ 1)
+    prims.tcgen05_fence(prims.Tcgen05Fence.AFTER_THREAD_SYNC)
+    d_sl = prims.make_tmem_ptr(tmem_raw + (TM_SL + slot * 64), F32)
+    if prims.elect_sync():
+        for k2 in cutlass.range_constexpr(1 if HKV == 1 else 2):
+            if cutlass.const_expr(j < 4):
+                a_op = prims.make_tmem_ptr(tmem_raw + (TM_PT + pb * 16 + k2 * 8), BF16)
+                b_op = d_do_mn.advance_start_address(j * QSLAB + k2 * 2048)
+            else:
+                a_op = prims.make_tmem_ptr(tmem_raw + (TM_DST + pb * 16 + k2 * 8), BF16)
+                b_op = d_q_mn.advance_start_address((j - 4) * QSLAB + k2 * 2048)
+            prims.tcgen05_mma(
+                prims.Tcgen05MMAKind.F16,
+                prims.CTAGroup.CTA_1,
+                d_sl,
+                a_op,
+                b_op,
+                idesc_kv,
+                k2 > 0,
+            )
+        prims.tcgen05_commit(b_lf.subview(slot), group=prims.CTAGroup.CTA_1)
+
+
+# Block-diagonal masking shares each gathered block across both KV heads.
+@cute.kernel
+def frost_qsa_bprop_sm100(
+    tma_q: cutlass.GridConstant[cuda.TensorMap],
+    tma_do: cutlass.GridConstant[cuda.TensorMap],
+    tma_k: cutlass.GridConstant[cuda.TensorMap],
+    tma_v: cutlass.GridConstant[cuda.TensorMap],
+    g_sparse_dv_acc: cute.Tensor,
+    g_lse: cute.Tensor,
+    g_delta: cute.Tensor,
+    g_dq: cute.Tensor,
+    g_sparse_dk_acc: cute.Tensor,
+    g_sparse_blocks: cute.Tensor,
+    g_counts: cute.Tensor,
+    g_lo: cute.Tensor,
+    g_hi: cute.Tensor,
+    g_first: cute.Tensor,
+    g_last: cute.Tensor,
+    T: I32,
+    nctas: I32,
+    scale: F32,
+    HQ: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+    HKV: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+    nonfinite,
+):
+    if cutlass.const_expr(nonfinite is not None):
+        if nonfinite[0] == 0:
+            cute.arch.nvvm.exit()
+    hint_ld = cutlass.Int64(L2_EVICT_FIRST)
+    tidx, _, _ = cute.arch.thread_idx()
+    bid, _, _ = cute.arch.block_idx()
+    warp = cute.arch.warp_idx()
+    lane = tidx % 32
+
+    smem = cutlass.Array(I32, SMEM_BYTES // 4, space=cutlass.AddressSpace.smem, alignment=1024)
+    b_qf = cutlass.Array(cutlass.Int64, 1, space=cutlass.AddressSpace.smem, alignment=8)
+    b_qe = cutlass.Array(cutlass.Int64, 1, space=cutlass.AddressSpace.smem, alignment=8)
+    b_kf = cutlass.Array(cutlass.Int64, 2, space=cutlass.AddressSpace.smem, alignment=8)
+    b_ke = cutlass.Array(cutlass.Int64, 2, space=cutlass.AddressSpace.smem, alignment=8)
+    b_kr = cutlass.Array(cutlass.Int64, 2, space=cutlass.AddressSpace.smem, alignment=8)
+    b_vf = cutlass.Array(cutlass.Int64, 1, space=cutlass.AddressSpace.smem, alignment=8)
+    b_ve = cutlass.Array(cutlass.Int64, 1, space=cutlass.AddressSpace.smem, alignment=8)
+    b_sf = cutlass.Array(cutlass.Int64, 1, space=cutlass.AddressSpace.smem, alignment=8)
+    b_pf = cutlass.Array(cutlass.Int64, 2, space=cutlass.AddressSpace.smem, alignment=8)
+    b_pe = cutlass.Array(cutlass.Int64, 2, space=cutlass.AddressSpace.smem, alignment=8)
+    b_lf = cutlass.Array(cutlass.Int64, NSL, space=cutlass.AddressSpace.smem, alignment=8)
+    b_le = cutlass.Array(cutlass.Int64, NSL, space=cutlass.AddressSpace.smem, alignment=8)
+    b_dqf = cutlass.Array(cutlass.Int64, 1, space=cutlass.AddressSpace.smem, alignment=8)
+    b_dqe = cutlass.Array(cutlass.Int64, 1, space=cutlass.AddressSpace.smem, alignment=8)
+    tmem_slot = cutlass.Array(I32, 1, space=cutlass.AddressSpace.smem, alignment=4)
+
+    # Keep unused K rows finite for the masked dQ MMA.
+    zero4 = cutlass.Vector.from_elements([I32(0), I32(0), I32(0), I32(0)], I32)
+    sbase = smem.data_ptr()
+    for it in cutlass.range(tidx, SMEM_BYTES // 16, NTHREADS, unroll=1):
+        (sbase + it * 4).store(zero4, alignment=16)
+
+    if warp == 0:
+        if prims.elect_sync():
+            prims.prefetch_tensormap(tma_q.get_ptr())
+            prims.prefetch_tensormap(tma_do.get_ptr())
+            prims.prefetch_tensormap(tma_k.get_ptr())
+            prims.prefetch_tensormap(tma_v.get_ptr())
+            prims.mbarrier_init(b_qf, 1)
+            prims.mbarrier_init(b_qe, 1)
+            for s in cutlass.range_constexpr(2):
+                prims.mbarrier_init(b_kf.subview(s), 1)
+                prims.mbarrier_init(b_ke.subview(s), 1)
+                prims.mbarrier_init(b_kr.subview(s), 1)
+                prims.mbarrier_init(b_pf.subview(s), 4)
+                prims.mbarrier_init(b_pe.subview(s), 1)
+            prims.mbarrier_init(b_sf, 1)
+            prims.mbarrier_init(b_vf, 1)
+            prims.mbarrier_init(b_ve, 1)
+            for s in cutlass.range_constexpr(NSL):
+                prims.mbarrier_init(b_lf.subview(s), 1)
+                prims.mbarrier_init(b_le.subview(s), 4)
+            prims.mbarrier_init(b_dqf, 1)
+            prims.mbarrier_init(b_dqe, 4)
+    if warp == 2:
+        prims.tcgen05_alloc(tmem_slot, TM_COLS, group="cta_1")
+        prims.tcgen05_relinquish_alloc_permit(group="cta_1")
+    prims.fence_mbarrier_init()
+    prims.fence_proxy(prims.Proxy.ASYNC_SHARED, space=prims.SharedSpace.shared_cta)
+    prims.barrier_cta_sync(0)
+
+    tmem_raw = tmem_slot.load()
+    tmem_col0 = tmem_raw & I32(0xFFFF)
+    tmem_row0 = tmem_raw >> I32(16)
+
+    p_lse = g_lse.iterator.raw_ptr()
+    p_delta = g_delta.iterator.raw_ptr()
+    p_dq = g_dq.iterator.raw_ptr()
+    p_sparse_dk_acc = g_sparse_dk_acc.iterator.raw_ptr()
+    p_sparse_dv_acc = g_sparse_dv_acc.iterator.raw_ptr()
+    p_sparse_blocks = g_sparse_blocks.iterator.raw_ptr()
+    p_counts = g_counts.iterator.raw_ptr()
+    p_lo = g_lo.iterator.raw_ptr()
+    p_hi = g_hi.iterator.raw_ptr()
+    p_first = g_first.iterator.raw_ptr()
+    p_last = g_last.iterator.raw_ptr()
+    capacity = I64(g_sparse_blocks.shape[1])
+
+    # Each role fits the 128-register budget.
+    wg = warp // 4
+    if wg == 0:
+        # The TMA unit zero-fills tokens past T, which keeps the masked rows of a tail block finite.
+        if warp == 0:
+            gc = I32(0)
+            nq = I32(0)
+            for qq in cutlass.range(bid, T, nctas, unroll=1):
+                qi = qq
+                nblk = (p_counts + (qi // 2 if cutlass.const_expr(nonfinite is not None) else qi)).load()
+                if nblk > 0:
+                    lrow = p_sparse_blocks + I64(qi // 2 if cutlass.const_expr(nonfinite is not None) else qi) * capacity
+                    nchunks = (nblk + (CHB - 1)) // CHB
+                    _wait(b_qe, (nq & 1) ^ 1)
+                    if prims.elect_sync():
+                        prims.mbarrier_arrive_expect_tx(b_qf, 8 * Q_BOX_BYTES)
+                        for s in cutlass.range_constexpr(4):
+                            prims.cp_async_bulk_tensor_shared_cta_global(
+                                sbase + (OFF_Q + s * QSLAB) // 4,
+                                tma_q.get_ptr(),
+                                (s * 64, 0, qi),
+                                b_qf,
+                            )
+                            prims.cp_async_bulk_tensor_shared_cta_global(
+                                sbase + (OFF_DO + s * QSLAB) // 4,
+                                tma_do.get_ptr(),
+                                (s * 64, 0, qi),
+                                b_qf,
+                            )
+                    # Prefetch the next chunk with in-bounds index loads.
+                    m0 = lane
+                    if m0 >= nblk:
+                        m0 = I32(0)
+                    xnext = (lrow + m0).load()
+                    for c in cutlass.range(nchunks, unroll=1):
+                        cgc = gc + c
+                        st = cgc & 1
+                        kpar = (cgc >> 1) & 1
+                        xcur = xnext
+                        if c + 1 < nchunks:
+                            m1 = (c + 1) * CHB + lane
+                            if m1 >= nblk:
+                                m1 = I32(0)
+                            xnext = (lrow + m1).load()
+                        m = c * CHB + lane
+                        blk = xcur
+                        if cutlass.const_expr(nonfinite is not None):
+                            blk = blk & I32((1 << 28) - 1)
+                        ok = m < nblk
+                        if lane >= CHB:
+                            ok = False
+                        nval = nblk - c * CHB
+                        if nval > CHB:
+                            nval = I32(CHB)
+                        tbytes = nval * BLK_SMEM
+                        _wait(b_ke.subview(st), kpar ^ 1)
+                        if prims.elect_sync():
+                            prims.mbarrier_arrive_expect_tx(b_kf.subview(st), tbytes)
+                        prims.bar_warp_sync(0xFFFFFFFF)
+                        if ok:
+                            prims.cp_async_bulk_tensor_shared_cta_global(
+                                sbase + (OFF_K + st * K_STAGE + lane * BLK_SMEM) // 4,
+                                tma_k.get_ptr(),
+                                (0, 0, (p_first + blk).load(), 0),
+                                b_kf.subview(st),
+                                l2_cache_hint=hint_ld,
+                            )
+                        _wait(b_ve, (cgc & 1) ^ 1)
+                        if prims.elect_sync():
+                            prims.mbarrier_arrive_expect_tx(b_vf, tbytes)
+                        prims.bar_warp_sync(0xFFFFFFFF)
+                        if ok:
+                            prims.cp_async_bulk_tensor_shared_cta_global(
+                                sbase + (OFF_V + lane * BLK_SMEM) // 4,
+                                tma_v.get_ptr(),
+                                (0, 0, (p_first + blk).load(), 0),
+                                b_vf,
+                                l2_cache_hint=hint_ld,
+                            )
+                    gc = gc + nchunks
+                    nq = nq + 1
+
+        # Mask K before the dQ MMA: multiplying zero dS by NaN must not leak across a packed boundary.
+        if warp == 1:
+            gc = I32(0)
+            for qi in cutlass.range(bid, T, nctas, unroll=1):
+                nblk = (p_counts + (qi // 2 if cutlass.const_expr(nonfinite is not None) else qi)).load()
+                if nblk > 0:
+                    lrow = p_sparse_blocks + I64(qi // 2 if cutlass.const_expr(nonfinite is not None) else qi) * capacity
+                    lower, upper = (p_lo + qi).load(), (p_hi + qi).load()
+                    nchunks = (nblk + CHB - 1) // CHB
+                    for c in cutlass.range(nchunks, unroll=1):
+                        cgc = gc + c
+                        st = cgc & 1
+                        _wait(b_kf.subview(st), (cgc >> 1) & 1)
+                        # Fully valid chunks need no shared-memory writes.
+                        needs_mask = False
+                        if lane < CHB:
+                            needs_mask = True
+                            if c * CHB + lane < nblk:
+                                block = (lrow + c * CHB + lane).load()
+                                owned = True
+                                if cutlass.const_expr(nonfinite is not None):
+                                    owned = ((block >> (28 + qi % 2)) & 1) != 0
+                                    block = block & I32((1 << 28) - 1)
+                                begin, end = (p_first + block).load(), (p_last + block).load()
+                                needs_mask = not (owned & (begin >= lower) & (begin + 3 <= upper) & (begin + 3 <= end) & (begin >= 0) & (begin + 3 < T))
+                        if cute.arch.vote_ballot_sync(needs_mask) != 0:
+                            for b in cutlass.range(CHB, unroll=1):
+                                selected = c * CHB + b < nblk
+                                first, last = I32(0), I32(-1)
+                                if selected:
+                                    block = (lrow + c * CHB + b).load()
+                                    if cutlass.const_expr(nonfinite is not None):
+                                        selected = ((block >> (28 + qi % 2)) & 1) != 0
+                                        block = block & I32((1 << 28) - 1)
+                                    first, last = (p_first + block).load(), (p_last + block).load()
+                                for half in cutlass.range_constexpr(2):
+                                    token = first + lane // 16 + half * 2
+                                    valid = selected & (token >= lower) & (token <= upper) & (token <= last) & (token >= 0) & (token < T)
+                                    if not valid:
+                                        row = lane // 8 + half * 4
+                                        for slab in cutlass.range_constexpr(4):
+                                            offset = OFF_K + st * K_STAGE + b * BLK_SMEM + slab * SLAB + row * 128 + (lane % 8) * 16
+                                            (sbase + offset // 4).store(zero4, alignment=16)
+                        prims.fence_proxy(prims.Proxy.ASYNC_SHARED, space=prims.SharedSpace.shared_cta)
+                        prims.bar_warp_sync(0xFFFFFFFF)
+                        if prims.elect_sync():
+                            prims.mbarrier_arrive(b_kr.subview(st))
+                    gc = gc + nchunks
+
+        # Interleave dV/dK(c) with scores(c+1). Finish dQ(c) before reusing dS shared memory.
+        if warp == 2:
+            idesc_s = prims.Tcgen05InstrDesc.build(
+                c_dtype=F32,
+                a_dtype=BF16,
+                b_dtype=BF16,
+                n_dim=16 if HKV == 1 else 24,
+                m_dim=128,
+                a_major=0,
+                b_major=0,
+            )
+            idesc_kv = prims.Tcgen05InstrDesc.build(
+                c_dtype=F32,
+                a_dtype=BF16,
+                b_dtype=BF16,
+                n_dim=64,
+                m_dim=128,
+                a_major=0,
+                b_major=1,
+            )
+            idesc_q = prims.Tcgen05InstrDesc.build(
+                c_dtype=F32,
+                a_dtype=BF16,
+                b_dtype=BF16,
+                n_dim=16 if HKV == 1 else 24,
+                m_dim=128,
+                a_major=1,
+                b_major=1,
+            )
+            SW128 = prims.Tcgen05SmemSwizzle.SWIZZLE_128B
+            SWN = prims.Tcgen05SmemSwizzle.NONE
+            # K/V tile, K-major SW128: 8-row atoms (one block) at 4 KB, slabs of 64 dims at 1 KB inside a block
+            d_k_kmaj = _desc(sbase + OFF_K // 4, 16, BLK_SMEM, SW128)
+            d_v_kmaj = _desc(sbase + OFF_V // 4, 16, BLK_SMEM, SW128)
+            # K tile read as K^T (MN-major SW128): leading byte offset = next 64-dim slab (1 KB), stride byte offset = next 8 rows
+            d_k_mn = _desc(sbase + OFF_K // 4, SLAB, BLK_SMEM, SW128)
+            # Q/dO as B of S^T/dP^T (K-major SW128, 24 rows) and as B of dK/dV (MN-major SW128)
+            d_q_kmaj = _desc(sbase + OFF_Q // 4, 16, 1024, SW128)
+            d_do_kmaj = _desc(sbase + OFF_DO // 4, 16, 1024, SW128)
+            d_q_mn = _desc(sbase + OFF_Q // 4, QSLAB, 1024, SW128)
+            d_do_mn = _desc(sbase + OFF_DO // 4, QSLAB, 1024, SW128)
+            # dS^T as B of dQ^T (MN-major, no swizzle): leading byte offset = next 8 K-rows, stride byte offset = next 8 columns
+            d_ds_mn = _desc(sbase + OFF_DS // 4, 384, 128, SWN)
+
+            gc = I32(0)
+            nq = I32(0)
+            for qq in cutlass.range(bid, T, nctas, unroll=1):
+                qi = qq
+                nblk = (p_counts + (qi // 2 if cutlass.const_expr(nonfinite is not None) else qi)).load()
+                if nblk > 0:
+                    lrow = p_sparse_blocks + I64(qi // 2 if cutlass.const_expr(nonfinite is not None) else qi) * capacity
+                    nchunks = (nblk + (CHB - 1)) // CHB
+                    _wait(b_qf, nq & 1)
+                    for c in cutlass.range(nchunks + 1, unroll=1):
+                        # Interleave dQ, S, and dP with eight dV/dK slices. Wait before reusing S/dP.
+                        cgc = gc + c
+                        st = cgc & 1
+                        cgb = cgc - 1  # chunk whose backward half is issued this iteration
+                        pb = cgb & 1
+                        if c >= 1:
+                            _wait(b_pf.subview(pb), (cgb >> 1) & 1)
+                            prims.fence_proxy(prims.Proxy.ASYNC_SHARED, space=prims.SharedSpace.shared_cta)
+                            prims.tcgen05_fence(prims.Tcgen05Fence.AFTER_THREAD_SYNC)
+                        if c < nchunks:
+                            _wait(b_kr.subview(st), (cgc >> 1) & 1)
+                            prims.fence_proxy(prims.Proxy.ASYNC_SHARED, space=prims.SharedSpace.shared_cta)
+                            prims.tcgen05_fence(prims.Tcgen05Fence.AFTER_THREAD_SYNC)
+                        dk_st = d_k_kmaj.advance_start_address(st * K_STAGE)
+                        dk_mn = d_k_mn.advance_start_address(pb * K_STAGE)
+                        acc_q = c > 1  # the first chunk of a query initialises the dQ accumulator
+                        for j in cutlass.range_constexpr(8):
+                            if c >= 1:
+                                _bwd_slice(j, cgb, pb, b_le, b_lf, tmem_raw, d_do_mn, d_q_mn, idesc_kv, HKV)
+                            if cutlass.const_expr(j >= 2 and j < 4):
+                                if c < nchunks:
+                                    for kk in cutlass.range(8, unroll=1):
+                                        k16 = kk + 8 * (j - 2)
+                                        if prims.elect_sync():
+                                            prims.tcgen05_mma(
+                                                prims.Tcgen05MMAKind.F16,
+                                                prims.CTAGroup.CTA_1,
+                                                prims.make_tmem_ptr(tmem_raw + TM_S, F32),
+                                                dk_st.advance_start_address((k16 >> 2) * SLAB + (k16 & 3) * 32),
+                                                d_q_kmaj.advance_start_address((k16 >> 2) * QSLAB + (k16 & 3) * 32),
+                                                idesc_s,
+                                                k16 > 0,
+                                            )
+                            elif cutlass.const_expr(j < 2):
+                                if c >= 1:
+                                    if cutlass.const_expr(j == 0):
+                                        if c == 1:
+                                            _wait(b_dqe, (nq & 1) ^ 1)
+                                            prims.tcgen05_fence(prims.Tcgen05Fence.AFTER_THREAD_SYNC)
+                                    hh = j
+                                    for component in cutlass.range_constexpr(3):
+                                        for kk in cutlass.range(CHB // 2, unroll=1):
+                                            if prims.elect_sync():
+                                                prims.tcgen05_mma(
+                                                    prims.Tcgen05MMAKind.F16,
+                                                    prims.CTAGroup.CTA_1,
+                                                    prims.make_tmem_ptr(tmem_raw + (TM_DQ + hh * 32), F32),
+                                                    dk_mn.advance_start_address(hh * 2 * SLAB + kk * 2 * BLK_SMEM),
+                                                    d_ds_mn.advance_start_address(component * DS_BYTES + kk * 768),
+                                                    idesc_q,
+                                                    acc_q | (kk > 0) | (component > 0),
+                                                )
+                                    if cutlass.const_expr(j == 1):
+                                        if prims.elect_sync():
+                                            prims.tcgen05_commit(b_ke.subview(pb), group=prims.CTAGroup.CTA_1)
+                                            prims.tcgen05_commit(b_ve, group=prims.CTAGroup.CTA_1)
+                                            if c == nchunks:
+                                                prims.tcgen05_commit(b_dqf, group=prims.CTAGroup.CTA_1)
+                            elif cutlass.const_expr(j < 6):
+                                if c < nchunks:
+                                    if cutlass.const_expr(j == 4):

+@cute.kernel
+def frost_qsa_scan_kv(k: cute.Tensor, v: cute.Tensor, partials: cute.Tensor):
+    tid = cute.arch.thread_idx()[0]
+    block = cute.arch.block_idx()[0]
+    bad = Int32(0)
+    for step in cutlass.range_constexpr(8):
+        index = Int64(block) * 1024 + tid + step * 128
+        if index < k.shape[0]:
+            kb = Float32(k[index]).bitcast(Int32) & Int32(0x7F800000)
+            vb = Float32(v[index]).bitcast(Int32) & Int32(0x7F800000)
+            if (kb == Int32(0x7F800000)) or (vb == Int32(0x7F800000)):
+                bad = Int32(1)
+    bad = cute.arch.warp_reduction_max(bad)
+    if tid % 32 == 0:
+        partials[Int64(block) * 4 + tid // 32] = bad
+

+@cute.kernel
+def frost_qsa_tile_bounds(lo: cute.Tensor, hi: cute.Tensor, partials: cute.Tensor, modes: cute.Tensor, ranges: cute.Tensor):
+    tid = cute.arch.thread_idx()[0]
+    tile = cute.arch.block_idx()[0]
+    row = tile * TILE_M + tid
+    total = Int32(lo.shape[0])
+    low, high, bad = total, Int32(-1), Int32(0)
+    if row < total:
+        left = cute.math.max(lo[row], Int32(0))
+        right = cute.math.min(hi[row], total - 1)
+        if left <= right:
+            low, high = left, right
+    for index in cutlass.range(tid, Int32(partials.shape[0]), 128):
+        bad = bad | partials[index]
+    low = cute.arch.warp_reduction(low, lambda x, y: cute.math.min(x, y))
+    high = cute.arch.warp_reduction_max(high)
+    bad = cute.arch.warp_reduction_max(bad)
+    scratch = utils.SmemAllocator().allocate_tensor(Int32, cute.make_layout(12), byte_alignment=4)
+    if tid % 32 == 0:
+        scratch[tid // 32] = low
+        scratch[4 + tid // 32] = high
+        scratch[8 + tid // 32] = bad
+    cute.arch.sync_threads()
+    if tid == 0:
+        left, right, unsafe = total, Int32(-1), Int32(0)
+        for warp in cutlass.range_constexpr(4):
+            left = cute.math.min(left, scratch[warp])
+            right = cute.math.max(right, scratch[4 + warp])
+            unsafe = unsafe | scratch[8 + warp]
+        begin, chunks = Int32(0), Int32(1)
+        if left <= right:
+            begin = left & Int32(-128)
+            end = (right + 128) & Int32(-128)
+            chunks = (end - begin) // 128
+            if end - begin > MAX_SPAN:
+                unsafe = Int32(1)
+        modes[tile] = unsafe
+        ranges[tile, 0], ranges[tile, 1] = begin, chunks

+@cute.kernel
+def frost_qsa_schedule(modes: cute.Tensor, ranges: cute.Tensor, order: cute.Tensor):
+    """Rank query tiles by descending dense work so the largest launch first."""
+    tid = Int32(cute.arch.thread_idx()[0])
+    count = Int32(modes.shape[0])
+    keys = utils.SmemAllocator().allocate_tensor(Int32, cute.make_layout(MAX_SORT), byte_alignment=16)
+    if count <= Int32(MAX_SORT):
+        for tile in cutlass.range(tid, count, 128):
+            work = Int32(0)
+            if modes[tile] == 0:
+                work = ranges[tile, 1]
+            keys[tile] = work
+        cute.arch.sync_threads()
+        for tile in cutlass.range(tid, count, 128):
+            mine = keys[tile]
+            rank = Int32(0)
+            for other in cutlass.range(count):
+                theirs = keys[other]
+                if (theirs > mine) or ((theirs == mine) and (other < tile)):
+                    rank = rank + 1
+            order[rank] = tile
+    else:
+        for tile in cutlass.range(tid, count, 128):
+            order[tile] = tile

+def make_inputs(lengths, hq, hkv, *, empty=False, all_selected=False):
+    rng = torch.Generator().manual_seed(123)
+    total = sum(lengths)
+    first, last, bases, origins = [], [], [], []
+    offset, base = 0, 0
+    for length in lengths:
+        starts = list(range(offset, offset + length, 4))
+        first.extend(starts)
+        last.extend(min(i + 3, offset + length - 1) for i in starts)
+        bases.extend([base] * length)
+        origins.extend([offset] * length)
+        offset += length
+        base += len(starts)
+    first, last, bases, origins = [torch.tensor(x, dtype=torch.int32) for x in (first, last, bases, origins)]
+    hi = torch.arange(total, dtype=torch.int32)
+    valid = (last[None] >= origins[:, None]) & (first[None] <= hi[:, None])
+    sel = valid if all_selected else valid & (torch.rand((total, base), generator=rng) > 0.4)
+    if empty:
+        sel[::7] = False
+
+    def normal(heads):
+        return torch.randn((total, heads, 256), generator=rng).to(torch.bfloat16).cuda()
+
+    return dict(
+        q=normal(hq),
+        k=normal(hkv),
+        v=normal(hkv),
+        sel_blocks=sel.byte().cuda(),
+        lo=origins.cuda(),
+        hi=hi.cuda(),
+        blk_base=bases.cuda(),
+        tok_base=origins.clone().cuda(),
+        block_first=first.cuda(),
+        block_last=last.cuda(),
+        scale=1 / 16,
+    )

+@torch.no_grad()
+def reference(inputs, grad_out=None, saved_out=None, saved_lse=None):
+    q, k, v = (inputs[name].double() for name in ("q", "k", "v"))
+    total, hq, _ = q.shape
+    hkv = k.shape[1]
+    keys = torch.arange(total, device=q.device)
+    blocks = inputs["blk_base"][:, None] + (keys[None] - inputs["tok_base"][:, None]) // 4
+    in_bounds = (blocks >= 0) & (blocks < inputs["sel_blocks"].shape[1])
+    selected = torch.gather(inputs["sel_blocks"], 1, blocks.clamp(0, inputs["sel_blocks"].shape[1] - 1).long()) != 0
+    valid = in_bounds & selected & (keys[None] >= inputs["lo"][:, None]) & (keys[None] <= inputs["hi"][:, None])
+    out, lse = torch.empty_like(q), torch.empty((hq, total), dtype=torch.float64, device=q.device)
+    dq, dk, dv = torch.zeros_like(q), torch.zeros_like(k), torch.zeros_like(v)
+    for head in range(hq):
+        kv_head = head // (hq // hkv)
+        scores = (q[:, head] @ k[:, kv_head].T) * inputs["scale"]
+        scores.masked_fill_(~valid, -torch.inf)
+        normalizer = torch.logsumexp(scores, dim=-1)
+        safe_lse = torch.where(normalizer.isfinite(), normalizer, 0)
+        p = torch.exp(scores - safe_lse[:, None])
+        out[:, head] = p @ v[:, kv_head]
+        lse[head] = normalizer
+        if grad_out is not None:
+            do = grad_out[:, head].double()
+            stats = saved_lse[head].double()
+            p = torch.exp(scores - torch.where(stats.isfinite(), stats, 0)[:, None])
+            p = torch.where(valid & stats.isfinite()[:, None], p, 0)
+            delta = (do * saved_out[:, head].double()).sum(-1)
+            ds = p * (do @ v[:, kv_head].T - delta[:, None])
+            dq[:, head] = (ds @ k[:, kv_head]) * inputs["scale"]
+            dk[:, kv_head] += (ds.T @ q[:, head]) * inputs["scale"]
+            dv[:, kv_head] += p.T @ do
+    if grad_out is not None:
+        return dq, dk, dv
+    return out.to(inputs["q"].dtype), out, lse
+
+
+def assert_close(actual, expected):
+    assert torch.equal(torch.isneginf(actual), torch.isneginf(expected))
+    finite = expected.isfinite()
+    torch.testing.assert_close(actual[finite].double(), expected[finite].double(), atol=0.04, rtol=0.04)
+    diff = (actual[finite].double() - expected[finite].double()).norm()
+    # Absolute error governs analytically zero gradients.
+    bound = max(0.025 * expected[finite].double().norm().item(), 1e-3)
+    assert diff.item() <= bound

If a worker is killed, for example by timeout during `save`, `result_path` can hold partial JSON. `json.loads` then raises and aborts the whole run. The abort loses the results of all remaining cases. Catch `json.JSONDecodeError` and record a failed result.

+            try:
+                result = json.loads(result_path.read_text()) if result_path.exists() else {}
+            except json.JSONDecodeError:
+                result = {"error": "unreadable result file"}
             if exit_code != 0:

**Fill the captured outputs with NaN before each replay.**

The first replay reads outputs that the capture never wrote, so a missing write fails that iteration. The third replay is different. It runs after a clean replay has already written correct `out`/`dq`/`dk`/`dv` values. Suppose the poisoned replay does not write rows `[:stop]` (for example, an early exit on the nonfinite path). Then `isfinite` and `assert_close` still pass on the stale clean values. AGENTS.md names this test as the canonical detector for paired nonfinite isolation, so it must not pass on stale output. The other replay tests in this file (`test_masked_kv_poison`, `test_paired_backward_mask_replay`, `test_dense_gather_replay`) already fill outputs with NaN before each replay.

+                                    w0 = va[4 * cc : 4 * cc + 4].bitcast(I32)
+                                else:
+                                    w0 = vb[4 * cc : 4 * cc + 4].bitcast(I32)
+                                (ep + srow * 32 + ((srow ^ cc) & 7) * 4).store(w0, alignment=16)
+                            prims.bar_warp_sync(0xFFFFFFFF)
+                            cl = lane & 7
+                            for kk in cutlass.range_constexpr(8):
+                                srow = kk * 4 + (lane >> 3)
+                                token = grow[kk] + (lane >> 3)
+                                if bok[kk] & (token >= 0) & (token < T):
+                                    v4 = (ep + srow * 32 + ((srow ^ cl) & 7) * 4).load(count=4, alignment=16).bitcast(F32)
+                                    goff = token * D + dblk * 64 + pg * 32 + cl * 4
+                                    if cutlass.const_expr(jj >= 2):
+                                        ptr = p_sparse_dk_acc + goff
+                                    else:
+                                        ptr = p_sparse_dv_acc + goff
+                                    prims.red(prims.ReductionOp.ADD, prims.ReductionType.F32, ptr, v4, mem_order=prims.MemOrder.RELAXED)
+                            prims.bar_warp_sync(0xFFFFFFFF)
+                gc = gc + nchunks

+    prims.tcgen05_fence(prims.Tcgen05Fence.BEFORE_THREAD_SYNC)
+    prims.barrier_cta_sync(0)
+    if warp == 2:
+        prims.tcgen05_dealloc(prims.make_tmem_ptr(tmem_raw, F32), TM_COLS, group="cta_1")
+
+
+frost_qsa_bprop_sm100.set_name_prefix("cudnn", remove_cutlass_symbol=True)
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _bprop_host(
+    q: cute.Tensor,
+    k: cute.Tensor,
+    v: cute.Tensor,
+    dout: cute.Tensor,
+    lse: cute.Tensor,
+    delta: cute.Tensor,
+    dq_acc: cute.Tensor,
+    dk_acc: cute.Tensor,
+    dv_acc: cute.Tensor,
+    ids: cute.Tensor,
+    counts: cute.Tensor,
+    lo: cute.Tensor,
+    hi: cute.Tensor,
+    first: cute.Tensor,
+    last: cute.Tensor,
+    scale: F32,
+    nctas: I32,
+    stream: cuda_driver.CUstream,
+    nonfinite=None,
+):
+    total = q.shape[0]
+    hq, hkv = cutlass.const_expr(q.shape[1]), cutlass.const_expr(k.shape[1])
+    flat = cute.make_layout((total * hq, D), stride=(D, 1))
+    tma_q = cuda.create_tensor_map_tiled_from_view(
+        cute.make_tensor(q.iterator, flat), box_dims=(NQ * GQ, 64), stride_order=(1, 0), swizzle=cuda.TensorMapSwizzle.s128b
+    )
+    tma_do = cuda.create_tensor_map_tiled_from_view(
+        cute.make_tensor(dout.iterator, flat), box_dims=(NQ * GQ, 64), stride_order=(1, 0), swizzle=cuda.TensorMapSwizzle.s128b
+    )
+    layout = cute.make_layout((total, hkv, 4, 64), stride=(hkv * D, D, 64, 1))
+    tma_k = cuda.create_tensor_map_tiled_from_view(
+        cute.make_tensor(k.iterator, layout), box_dims=(4, 1, 1, 64), stride_order=(3, 1, 0, 2), swizzle=cuda.TensorMapSwizzle.s128b
+    )
+    tma_v = cuda.create_tensor_map_tiled_from_view(
+        cute.make_tensor(v.iterator, layout), box_dims=(4, 1, 1, 64), stride_order=(3, 1, 0, 2), swizzle=cuda.TensorMapSwizzle.s128b
+    )
+    frost_qsa_bprop_sm100(
+        tma_q,
+        tma_do,
+        tma_k,
+        tma_v,
+        dv_acc,
+        lse,
+        delta,
+        dq_acc,
+        dk_acc,
+        ids,
+        counts,
+        lo,
+        hi,
+        first,
+        last,
+        I32(total),
+        (I32(total) + I32(NQ - 1)) // I32(NQ),
+        nctas,
+        scale,
+        hq,
+        hkv,
+        nonfinite,
+    ).launch(grid=(nctas, 1, 1), block=(NTHREADS, 1, 1), min_blocks_per_mp=1, stream=stream)
+
+
+def compile_kernel(dtype, query_heads, kv_heads, arch):
+    """Compile native THD geometry; tensor extents remain dynamic."""
+    if kv_heads == 2:
+        from .bprop_sm100_base import compile_kernel as compile_baseline
+
+        return compile_baseline(dtype, query_heads, kv_heads, arch)
+    from .bprop_helpers import compile_helpers, fake
+
+    if dtype != BF16 or (query_heads, kv_heads) != (GQ, 1):
+        raise ValueError("Batched QSA backward requires BF16, D256 and 12/1 heads")
+    if arch not in (100, 103):
+        raise ValueError(f"Blackwell QSA backward requires SM100 or SM103, got SM{arch}")
+    key = template_key(globals(), {"query_heads": query_heads, "kv_heads": kv_heads, "arch": arch}, "compile_kernel")
+    total, capacity, blocks, groups = cute.sym_int64(), cute.sym_int64(), cute.sym_int64(), cute.sym_int64()
+    q, kv = fake(BF16, (total, query_heads, D)), fake(BF16, (total, kv_heads, D))
+    aq, ak = fake(F32, (total, query_heads, D)), fake(F32, (total, kv_heads, D))
+    lse, delta = fake(F32, (query_heads, total), 4), fake(F32, (total, query_heads))
+    ids = fake(I32, (groups, capacity), 4)
+    rows, spans = fake(I32, (total,), 4), fake(I32, (blocks,), 4)
+    gcounts = fake(I32, (groups,), 4)
+    compiled = dict(compile_helpers(query_heads, kv_heads, arch))
+    compiled["main"] = compile_cached(
+        _bprop_host,
+        q,
+        kv,
+        kv,
+        q,
+        lse,
+        delta,
+        aq,
+        ak,
+        ak,
+        ids,
+        gcounts,
+        rows,
+        rows,
+        spans,
+        spans,
+        F32(1),
+        I32(1),
+        make_fake_stream(use_tvm_ffi_env_stream=False),
+        options=f"--enable-tvm-ffi --gpu-arch=sm_{arch}a",
+        cache_key=key,
+        symbol="qsa_backward",
+    )
+    from . import bprop_dispatch
+
+    compiled["dispatch"] = bprop_dispatch.compile_kernel(arch)
+    return compiled
+
+
+def launch(compiled, grad_out, q, k, v, out_fp32, lse, ids, counts, lo, hi, first, last, dq, dk, dv, scratch, scale, stream, num_sms):
+    """Launch with caller-owned outputs and scratch."""
+    if k.shape[1] == 2:
+        from .bprop_sm100_base import launch as launch_baseline
+
+        return launch_baseline(compiled, grad_out, q, k, v, out_fp32, lse, ids, counts, lo, hi, first, last, dq, dk, dv, scratch, scale, stream, num_sms)

+from pathlib import Path

+@cute.jit
+def _wait(bar, parity):

+@cute.jit
+def _bwd_slice(j, cgb, pb, b_le, b_lf, tmem_raw, d_do_mn, d_q_mn, idesc_kv, HKV: cutlass.Constexpr[int]):
+    gs = cgb * 8 + j
+    slot = gs % NSL

+@cute.kernel
+def frost_qsa_bprop_sm100(

+    tma_k: cutlass.GridConstant[cuda.TensorMap],

+                                prims.cp_async_bulk_tensor_shared_cta_global(
+                                    sbase + dst // 4,
+                                    tma_k.get_ptr(),
+                                    (0, 0, first, s),
+                                    b_kf.subview(st),
+                                )

+                        if prims.elect_sync():
+                            prims.mbarrier_arrive_expect_tx(b_vf, tbytes)
+                        prims.bar_warp_sync(0xFFFFFFFF)
+                        if ok:
+                            first = (p_first + (blk & BLK_MASK)).load()
+                            pair = lane >> 1
+                            half = lane & 1
+                            for s in cutlass.range_constexpr(4):
+                                dst = OFF_V + pair * CORE_SMEM + s * SLAB + half * BLOCK_SLAB
+                                prims.cp_async_bulk_tensor_shared_cta_global(
+                                    sbase + dst // 4,
+                                    tma_v.get_ptr(),
+                                    (0, 0, first, s),
+                                    b_vf,
+                                )
+                    gc = gc + nchunks
+                    nq = nq + 1
+
+        # Mask K before the dQ MMA: multiplying zero dS by NaN must not leak across a packed boundary.
+        if warp == 1:
+            gc = I32(0)
+            for qi in cutlass.range(bid, NG, nctas, unroll=1):
+                nblk = (p_counts + qi).load()
+                if nblk > 0:
+                    lrow = p_sparse_blocks + I64(qi) * capacity
+                    qbase = qi * NQ
+                    bnd_lo = []
+                    bnd_hi = []
+                    for i in cutlass.range_constexpr(NQ):
+                        qrow = qbase + i
+                        if qrow >= T:
+                            qrow = T - 1
+                        bnd_lo.append((p_lo + qrow).load())
+                        bnd_hi.append((p_hi + qrow).load())
+                    nchunks = (nblk + CHB - 1) // CHB
+                    for c in cutlass.range(nchunks, unroll=1):
+                        cgc = gc + c
+                        st = cgc & 1
+                        _wait(b_kf.subview(st), (cgc >> 1) & 1)
+                        # Fully valid chunks need no shared-memory writes.
+                        needs_mask = False
+                        if lane < CHB:
+                            needs_mask = True
+                            if c * CHB + lane < nblk:
+                                code = (lrow + c * CHB + lane).load()
+                                block = code & BLK_MASK
+                                begin, end = (p_first + block).load(), (p_last + block).load()
+                                covered = False
+                                for i in cutlass.range_constexpr(NQ):
+                                    covered = covered | ((((code >> (BLK_BITS + i)) & 1) != 0) & (begin >= bnd_lo[i]) & (begin + 3 <= bnd_hi[i]))
+                                spans = covered & (begin + 3 <= end) & (begin >= 0) & (begin + 3 < T)
+                                needs_mask = not spans
+                        if cute.arch.vote_ballot_sync(needs_mask) != 0:
+                            for b in cutlass.range(CHB, unroll=1):
+                                selected = c * CHB + b < nblk
+                                first, last = I32(0), I32(-1)
+                                code = I32(0)
+                                if selected:
+                                    code = (lrow + c * CHB + b).load()
+                                    block = code & BLK_MASK
+                                    first, last = (p_first + block).load(), (p_last + block).load()
+                                for row in cutlass.range_constexpr(4):
+                                    token = first + row
